# OneMall

> > OneMall is a Japanese proxy shopping service that enables international customers to purchase from Japan's top marketplaces like Mercari, Yahoo Auctions, and Rakuten with international shipping.

OneMall provides a comprehensive platform for buying Japanese products internationally, offering proxy purchasing, warehouse services, and logistics solutions. The service specializes in helping collectors and enthusiasts access anime figures, collectibles, and other Japanese goods from major domestic marketplaces.
